name: proofblade
description: ProofBlade (证锋), a Pi-based evidence-driven CTF agent harness.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@proofblade/atoms && npm run build --workspace=@proofblade/molecules && npm run build --workspace=@proofblade/materials && npm run typecheck --workspace=@proofblade/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace=@proofblade/gui
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests-with-watchdog.mjs --import tsx --test-concurrency=2 --test packages/*/tests/**/*.test.ts apps/*/tests/**/*.test.ts
scripts.test:parallel: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests-with-watchdog.mjs --import tsx --test-concurrency=4 --test packages/*/tests/**/*.test.ts apps/*/tests/**/*.test.ts
scripts.test:staged: npm run build && node scripts/run-test-stage.mjs all
scripts.test:atoms: npm run build --workspace=@proofblade/atoms && npm run test --workspace=@proofblade/atoms
scripts.test:molecules: npm run build --workspace=@proofblade/atoms && npm run build --workspace=@proofblade/molecules && npm run test --workspace=@proofblade/molecules
scripts.test:materials: npm run build && npm run test --workspace=@proofblade/materials
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run check:components && npm run check:change-contracts && npm run check:project-reports && npm run api:index:test && npm run api:index:check && npm run test:ci-gates && npm run test:platform-fault-matrix && npm run test:staged && npm run eval -- --enforce-gate && npm audit --omit=dev
scripts.cli: npm run build --workspace=@proofblade/atoms --silent && npm run build --workspace=@proofblade/molecules --silent && npm run build --workspace=@proofblade/materials --silent && tsx apps/cli/src/main.ts
scripts.eval: npm run build --workspace=@proofblade/atoms --silent && npm run build --workspace=@proofblade/molecules --silent && npm run build --workspace=@proofblade/materials --silent && tsx apps/cli/src/main.ts eval
scripts.session:service:combined: npm run build --silent && tsx scripts/session-runtime-service.ts --host-module scripts/session-runtime-combined-host.ts
scripts.session:service:combined:required: npm run build --silent && tsx scripts/session-runtime-service.ts --host-module scripts/session-runtime-combined-host.ts --require-ready
scripts.runtime:selfcheck: npm run build --silent && tsx apps/cli/src/main.ts runtime selfcheck
